tracks.title: Mesin Ais Lalu
tracks.subject: the driver of the ice resurfacing machine at a shopping-mall ice rink in Kuala Lumpur who clears the skaters off every two hours and crawls the machine round the rink at walking pace while forty teenagers wait at the gate

tracks.title: Bajet Atas Tisu
tracks.genre: bright piano-soul pop with brass (Tulus lane)
tracks.subject: a young man on his first payslip who sits at a kopitiam and budgets every ringgit on a paper napkin so he can take his girlfriend to the Italian restaurant in Bangsar she always pointed at through the glass

tracks.title: Tarik Tali Tin
tracks.subject: a Kelantan paddy farmer and his wife at harvest, taking turns all day in the bamboo hut at the edge of their plot pulling the long string of rattling tin cans to scare the burung pipit off the ripening grain, him pretending he is not tired while she brings the kopi in a tin can

tracks.title: Tali Lanyard Pejabat
tracks.subject: a young man alone in his newly rented room in Shah Alam whose curtain rod falls down every night with a crash; on the third night he gives up on the screws, ties the curtain back with his office lanyard and sleeps facing the orange streetlight outside the window

tracks.title: Sesenti, Seratus Tahun
tracks.subject: a cave guide at Gua Tempurung in Perak leading a noisy school group through the limestone chambers, telling them over and over not to touch the stalactites because the oil on their hands stops the stone growing and one centimetre takes about a hundred years

tracks.title: Ayam Abang, Cili Saya
tracks.genre: Malay folk-tune modern pop (pop moden bernuansa tradisional)
tracks.subject: a wife whose twelve new chilli plants by the back fence are dug up every day by her husband's three free-range kampung hens, until he offers her one warm egg a day as rent for the garden

tracks.title: Van Buku Khamis Kedua
tracks.subject: a man courting the librarian on the state mobile-library van that parks under the balai raya's angsana tree in his kampung every second Thursday evening, borrowing thick books he never opens (tractor manuals, a Russian novel, a cookbook in French) just to have a reason to come back and return them, until she stamps a return date that falls on a Saturday and writes her own name beside it

tracks.title: Ular Dalam Bonet
tracks.subject: a Bomba snake-catching unit pulling a 4-metre python out of the engine bay of a Proton Saga in a Shah Alam shopping-mall car park while the owner livestreams the whole thing, begging viewers for likes and asking the firemen to wave

tracks.title: Gendang Di Pagar Sekolah
tracks.subject: the security guard of a kampung primary school who brings his gendang to the gate on the first day of term, with the bus driver on serunai and the office clerk on gong, until the crying Year One children march in and the mothers are the ones crying

tracks.title: Kanan Ke Kiri
tracks.subject: a signboard painter with thirty years of steady hands who cannot read Jawi, joining a Tuesday-night adult Jawi class in the community hall so he can repaint the cloth shop's sign without getting a single letter backwards
